description: A frontend component named 'CheckoutModal' implemented using LightningJS Blits framework. It defines a modal UI for checkout with form fields, summary, and buttons, and handles state and user interactions.

classes.name: CheckoutModal
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a checkout modal dialog, handling form data, layout, and user interactions.

methods.name: focusName
methods.description: Sets the focus state to the name input field.

methods.name: focusEmail
methods.description: Sets the focus state to the email input field.

methods.name: focusAddress
methods.description: Sets the focus state to the address input field.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the checkout modal by invoking AppStore's close method.

methods.name: place
methods.description: Places the order by calling AppStore's placeOrder with current form data, if all required fields are filled.
